title: Aristide Benoist Slider
description: A full-screen horizontal image carousel where clicking a segment in the top progress-bar nav slides the track with gsap.to and a custom 'hop' CustomEase, tweens the background overlay to a random color, and re-animates two rows of large display-type title letters sliding in with power2.out. Triggered by click on the nav segments.

motion.motion_signature: click-driven horizontal slider: a fixed 3000vw flex strip is tweened to -i*100vw over 1.5s on the CustomEase "hop" curve (fast-in, long settle) while a fixed full-viewport overlay cross-tints to a new palette colour on the same 1.5s/hop; simultaneously all 14 title letters are re-created as spans set at x:±150 (sign = travel direction) and slid to 0 over 1s power2.out after a 0.125s delay — no scroll, no stagger, no physics

review.comment: El componente está bien, solo que el estilo de las letras con espacios no queda bien y el vídeo no se ve bien se ven saltos imagino por los bajos fps no se puede ver bien el movimiento se ve entrecortado. Mejora el diseño de las letras y que no tenga esos espacios que no tiene mucho sentido.
